thread:
maria (oncall): Pager received: increased 5xx rate on hosted-api-us-west-2. Alerting across gateways and host pools. Customer impact: some requests returning 502/504. Investigating.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created INC-2026-34517 — assigned to maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): I'm looking at gateway logs now. First glance: upstream provider timeout spikes at 12:03 UTC. Correlating with increased queue length on edge-proxy.

jonathan: Not seeing CPU/GPU spike on model hosts. Egress to external provider shows connection errors. Could be provider-side degradation or a transient network issue.

kevin: Can we temporarily widen the alert window and silence noisy alerts while we triage? Current rule is 1m window and it's flooding pages.

maria (oncall): Yes, silencing alert: /alert silence High5xxRate for 30m. Adding note so oncall won't get double pages.

alyssa: Re-routing suggestion: scale up gateway pool and enable failover to us-west-1 for critical routes. I can flip the routing policy if we need immediate mitigation.

maria (oncall): Please do. kevin, can you add a rule to route traffic to us-west-1 for model-serving when origin 5xx > 3% for 2m?

kevin: On it. Pushed temporary routing: traffic-split=90/10 us-west-2/us-west-1. Will monitor.

ruth: Dashboard updated: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/5xx-overview — added a panel for gateway 504 spikes and upstream latency. Sharing snapshot.

jonathan: After routing change, 5xx rate dropped from ~7% to ~1.5% within 2 minutes. Looks like failover helped.

maria (oncall): Good. Noting customer impact window: 12:02–12:08 UTC. Filing RCA ticket.

kevin: For alert tuning, propose change: use 5m aggregated window and threshold 5% with FOR 3m to reduce noise from transient provider hiccups. Also increase dedupe window in PagerDuty to 10m.

alyssa: Also propose synthetic canary checks for upstream provider endpoints every 30s. If provider latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive checks, trigger provider-specific alert (no page) so SRE can track without paging.

maria (oncall): Agree. Create follow-up tasks:
 - kevin: PR for alert rule change and PagerDuty dedupe (infra repo) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234
 - alyssa: Add canary jobs and dashboard panels
 - jonathan: Add runbook section for upstream provider failures, include failover steps and customer comms
 - ruth: Update SLA impact calc and notify CS if >1% user requests affected

kevin: Drafted PR for alert rule change. Snippet:
```
ALERT High5xxRate
IF sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route!~"/health"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
FOR 3m
```
Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234

maria (oncall): Will handoff to jonathan for postmortem work. @jonathan you're primary for RCA and follow-ups. I'll stay available for escalation.

jonathan: Acknowledged. I'll collect logs and vendor comms, and schedule RCA meeting. Tentative: today 16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Routing policy updated: traffic-split applied to service/hosted-api in us-west-2 -> us-west-1 (10%).

maria (oncall): Un-silencing non-critical alerts now; keeping High5xxRate silenced until PR merged. If anything regresses re-page.

alyssa: Noted. I'll create the canary job RFC and attach dashboard link.

ruth: CS notified: ticket #CS-7891 created for customer-impact summary.

maria (oncall): Final status: mitigation successful, partial failover reduced customer impact. Action items created. Closing incident notification; will update thread after RCA.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-34517 status set to RESOLVED by maria (oncall).

jonathan: I'll post RCA summary and follow-ups when ready. Thanks everyone :tada:
